run_find_top_rpn_proposals: run find_top_rpn_proposals to select top-k highest scoring RPN proposals per image and apply NMS
add_ground_truth_to_proposals: add ground truth boxes to RPN proposals for all images in a batch

review_add_ground_truth_to_proposals: review add_ground_truth_to_proposals and its single-image variant for concatenating gt with proposals
